title: Magnetic button
summary: A round button springs toward the cursor while its arrow travels 1.4 times as far on a softer spring, so the glyph leads the surface.
choreography: Idle: the pull target circles the centre on a small ellipse (7.5% by 5% of stage height) every 5.5s.
Cursor inside 60% of stage height: the button springs toward 42% of the cursor offset with spring(180, 14); the arrow adds another 40% on spring(130, 11) and overshoots.
Cursor leaves: both springs ring back to centre in about 600ms and the idle orbit resumes after 1.6s.
agentPrompt:
Build a magnetic circular button: on pointermove inside a field of radius 0.6 x container height, set the target offset to 0.42 x (cursor - centre), fading to zero over the outer third of the field.
Integrate a 2D spring per frame (stiffness 180, damping 14, dt clamped to 32ms) and apply it as transform: translate3d on the button.
Move the inner arrow by a further 0.4 x target on a softer spring (130, 11) so it travels 1.4x in total and overshoots.
On press, scale the button to 0.93 with spring(420, 26). Fade a dashed rest-position ring in as the button leaves centre.
When untouched, drive the target on a slow ellipse. Under prefers-reduced-motion keep the button still and leave only the press scale.

title: Copy link pill
summary: A dark "Copy link" pill narrows and turns white while its label blur-crossfades to a drawn check and "Copied", with a short scale bounce.
choreography: 0-420ms: width and background ease to the white "Copied" size on cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); the pill scales 1 to 0.94 to 1.035 to 1 over 460ms.
0-220ms: "Copy link" lifts 40% and blurs out while "Copied" rises from below and sharpens; the check stroke draws from 140ms to 460ms.
After 1.8s the pill reverses the same morph back to the dark resting state.
agentPrompt:
Build a pill button with two stacked labels: link icon + "Copy link" and check icon + "Copied". Measure each label and set the button width to label width + padding.
On click add a copied state: transition width 420ms and background-color/color 320ms with cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), dark (#232326) to white (#f4f4f5).
Crossfade the labels over 220ms with opacity + filter: blur(4-5px) + translateY(+-40%) scale(0.92); draw the check with stroke-dashoffset over 320ms after a 140ms delay.
Add a micro-bounce on the button: scale 1, 0.94 (22%), 1.035 (60%), 1 over 460ms. Revert after 1.8s.
Under prefers-reduced-motion drop the width, blur, movement and bounce and keep only a 160ms opacity crossfade.

title: Hue orbit ring
summary: A bright wave circles a ring of 12 dots, swelling each dot as it passes and leaving an exponential tail; a click reverses the orbit.
choreography: The wave head advances one dot every 117ms (1.4s per lap); the dot under it grows from radius 4.2 to 10.6 at full brightness.
Behind the head, size and brightness fall off as exp(-distance / 2.4 dots); ahead of it they drop within one dot.
Click: the direction eases through zero in about 300ms, the tail swaps sides and the centre disc flashes.
agentPrompt:
Draw 12 SVG circles evenly on a ring (radius 78 in a 400x300 viewBox) around a dim centre disc.
Each frame advance a head position at 12 dots per 1400ms (linear). For each dot compute its distance behind the head and a level = max(exp(-d / 2.4), exp(-(12 - d) * 3)).
Set r = 4.2 + 6.4 * level^1.2 and fill-opacity = 0.14 + 0.86 * level; move a soft radial-gradient glow to the head position.
On click flip the direction and ease the signed speed toward it with a 7/s exponential, blending the tail from one side to the other.
Under prefers-reduced-motion slow the lap to 3.6s, snap the head to whole dots and animate opacity only.

title: Bulge volume bar
summary: Dragging a vertical pill fills it with white while its outline swells around the fill level and stretches past the top or bottom stop before springing back.
choreography: Press and drag: the fill level follows on spring(260, 18) and the outline swells up to 9 units around it, in proportion to speed.
Past a stop: the drag meets exponential resistance (max 15% of the range) and the pill stretches taller and thinner to keep its area.
Release: the level springs back to the stop with about 12% overshoot and the swell relaxes on spring(220, 14) within 700ms.
agentPrompt:
Build a vertical pill slider as one SVG path rebuilt every frame; clip a white fill rect to the same path.
Follow the pointer with a spring (stiffness 260, damping 18). Add to the pill half-width a Gaussian centred on the fill level (sigma 24 units) whose amplitude is 5 while pressed plus 5 x |velocity|, capped at 9, smoothed by spring(220, 14).
Beyond 0 or 1 map the drag through a rubber band, limit * (1 - exp(-excess / limit)) with limit 0.15, and extend the pill at that end while narrowing it by range / (range + overshoot).
On release clamp the target to the stop and let the spring overshoot. Support arrow keys in steps of 10.
Under prefers-reduced-motion set the level directly with no swell, stretch or auto-demo.

title: OTP error shake
summary: Four code boxes fill one digit at a time, then the row rejects the code with a damped horizontal shake and a "Try again" note fades in.
choreography: 320-890ms: digits 2, 3, 7, 4 pop in 190ms apart (rise 35%, scale 0.8 to 1) while the focus ring steps to the next box.
1320-1740ms: the row shakes -10, +10, -6, +6, -2, +2, 0 px over 420ms; borders brighten and "Try again" fades in after 140ms.
After 1.7s the digits clear right to left, 45ms apart, and the loop restarts 520ms later.

Build four OTP boxes that fill in sequence every 190ms; each digit enters with opacity 0 to 1 and translateY(35%) scale(0.8) to none over 260ms.
On a wrong code run a 420ms keyframe shake on the whole row: translateX 0, -10px (12%), +10px (28%), -6px (44%), +6px (60%), -2px (76%), +2px (90%), 0, with ease-in-out between keyframes.
At the same time brighten the box borders and fade a "Try again" line in (opacity + 4px rise, 240ms, 140ms delay).
Restart the keyframes by removing the class, forcing a reflow and adding it again. Clear the digits after 1.7s.
Under prefers-reduced-motion skip the shake and the loop: show the error state with opacity changes only.

title: Elastic track slider
summary: A numbered pill thumb chases the pointer on a spring, stretching with its speed and pulling past the track ends with rubber-band resistance.
choreography: Drag: the thumb follows on spring(520, 34); it widens up to 1.5x and flattens to 0.79x in proportion to speed, and the nearest tick grows.
Past an end: travel is damped to at most 17% of the track and the rail stretches with the thumb.
Release: the target clamps to the end and the thumb rings back on spring(260, 20) in about 650ms; the number updates live.
agentPrompt:
Build a horizontal slider whose pill thumb shows the live value 0-100. Drive the thumb x with a spring: stiffness 520 / damping 34 while dragging, 260 / 20 after release.
Stretch the thumb by velocity: scaleX = 1 + min(0.5, |v| / trackWidth * 0.11), scaleY = 1 - 0.42 * that stretch, low-pass filtered at 18/s; counter-scale the number.
Beyond either end map the pointer through limit * (1 - exp(-excess / limit)) with limit = 17% of the track, and extend the rail to the thumb. Clamp the target on release.
Scale and brighten tick marks with a Gaussian around the thumb. Support arrow keys in steps of 5.
Under prefers-reduced-motion set the position directly with no stretch, overshoot or auto-glide.

title: Perspective tilt card
summary: A silver card tilts in perspective toward the cursor on a spring while a soft specular sheen and the drop shadow slide with the angle.
choreography: Idle: the card traces a figure-8, rotateY +-9deg every 7s with rotateX +-5deg at twice the frequency.
Cursor over the stage: rotateY tracks up to +-16deg and rotateX up to +-13deg on spring(170, 20); the card lifts to scale 1.04.
The sheen glides to the cursor side and brightens, the shadow shifts the opposite way; on leave everything settles in about 700ms.
agentPrompt:
Put a card inside a container with perspective of about 590px. Map the cursor to -1..1 across the container: rotateY = x * 16deg, rotateX = -y * 13deg.
Integrate both angles with a spring (stiffness 170, damping 20) every frame and apply rotateX/rotateY plus scale(1 + 0.04 * hover).
Move an oversized radial-gradient sheen layer by translate3d(30% * x, 24% * y) and raise its opacity from 0.5 to 0.9 with tilt magnitude.
Offset the box-shadow opposite to the tilt (-16px * x, 14px - 12px * y, blur 32px) and shift the card content 3px for parallax.
When idle drive the targets with sin(0.9t) * 9deg and sin(1.8t) * 5deg. Under prefers-reduced-motion drop the idle loop and cap the tilt at 4deg.

title: Eclipse crescent ring
summary: A thin white crescent orbits the edge of a matte sphere, thinning and thickening twice per lap as its bloom and rim highlight trade places.
choreography: A white disc sits behind the sphere, offset 1.3 to 5.5 units toward the orbit angle; the exposed sliver is the crescent, one lap per 3.6s.
As the offset grows the bloom widens and brightens; as it shrinks the rim arc inside the limb lengthens and brightens instead.
Hover: orbit speed eases to 3.2x over about 400ms and eases back on leave.
agentPrompt:
Stack three SVG shapes: a soft radial-gradient bloom ellipse, a white disc (r 62) and a dark radial-gradient sphere (r 62) on top.
Each frame advance an angle at one lap per 3600ms (linear). Offset the white disc from the sphere centre by d = 1.3 + 4.2 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sin(2 * angle + 1)) along that angle so only a crescent shows.
Place the bloom on the lit limb, rotate it to the angle and scale its radial width and opacity with d; rotate the sphere so its lit side faces the crescent.
Add a 1.2-unit rim arc via stroke-dasharray whose length and opacity grow as d shrinks.
On hover ease the speed toward 3.2x with a 5/s exponential. Under prefers-reduced-motion render one static crescent.

title: Infinity stroke loop
summary: A bright capsule runs around a figure-8 path, shortening from 24% to 10% of the path as it squeezes through the crossover; a click adds a burst of speed.
choreography: The capsule laps the path every 2.4s over a dim base stroke, with a wide low-opacity halo under it.
Within 7.5% of the path around the crossover it compresses from 24% to 10% of the path length and moves 30% faster.
Click: speed jumps to 3.6x and decays with a 450ms time constant while the stroke thickens from 13 to 15.2.
agentPrompt:
Draw a closed figure-8 SVG path three times: a dim base (opacity 0.12), a wide halo and a bright stroke with round caps.
Set stroke-dasharray to [dash, total - dash] and stroke-dashoffset to -(pos - dash / 2), advancing pos by total / 2400ms each frame (linear).
Compute pinch = exp(-(distance to crossover / (0.075 * total))^2); dash = total * (0.24 - 0.14 * pinch) and speed x (1 + 0.3 * pinch).
On click add a speed boost of 2.6 that decays as exp(-2.2t) and widen the stroke by up to 2.2 with it.
Under prefers-reduced-motion run a constant-length capsule at a quarter of the speed with no pinch or pulse.

title: Morphing align switch
summary: A white pill springs between three alignment options while three text bars below slide and resize into the chosen alignment, one after another.
choreography: 0ms: the pill springs to the chosen option on spring(320, 26), stretching up to 1.28x with speed; icon colours swap over 200ms.
0, 45, 90ms: each bar starts moving to its new x offset and width on spring(240, 22).
By about 500ms pill and bars have settled with a small overshoot and the animation loop sleeps.
agentPrompt:
Build a three-option segmented control (left, centre, right) with an absolutely positioned highlight pill.
On select, spring the pill x to the option (stiffness 320, damping 26) and add scaleX = 1 + min(0.28, |v| * 0.045).
Below it render three bars; give each a width set per alignment (e.g. left 100/66/84%, centre 72/100/50%, right 86/58/100%) and an x offset of align * (block width - bar width).
Spring both width and offset per bar (240, 22), staggered 45ms per bar. Stop the frame loop once all springs settle.
Support arrow keys and roving tabindex. Under prefers-reduced-motion jump straight to the final values.

title: Stacked spring toasts
summary: Three notifications sit in a compressed stack that fans out into a full column on hover, and a new toast pushed from below shifts the others one level deeper.
choreography: Rest: toasts sit at scale 1, 0.94, 0.88 and peek 0, -10, -20px above the front one.
Hover: every toast springs to scale 1 and a full row of spacing (height + 8px) on spring(260, 24), settling in about 550ms.
Push: a new toast rises from below while the others step back one level; the fourth fades out and is removed.
agentPrompt:
Keep toasts in an array, newest first, absolutely positioned at the bottom with transform-origin top centre.
Collapsed targets for index i: translateY(-10px * i), scale(1 - 0.06 * i). Expanded on hover: translateY(-(height + 8px) * i), scale(1). Opacity 1 for the first three, 0 beyond.
Spring y, scale and opacity per toast every frame (stiffness 260, damping 24) and stop the loop when all are settled.
A new toast starts one toast height below with opacity 0 and springs to index 0; remove toasts past the third once their opacity is under 0.02.
Under prefers-reduced-motion set the targets directly without springs or auto-demo.

title: Rubber-band bottom sheet
summary: A white sheet springs up from the bottom of a phone frame while the app behind it scales to 0.94, rounds its top corners and dims; dragging the sheet resists upward and dismisses downward.
choreography: Open: the sheet rises on spring(300, 28) in about 500ms; the app scales 1 to 0.94, its top corners round to 12px and the scrim reaches 42%.
Drag: downward the sheet follows the pointer 1:1 and the app, corners and scrim track its progress; upward it yields at most 10% of the frame height.
Release: past 35% of the travel or faster than 600px/s it closes, otherwise it springs back, carrying the release velocity.
agentPrompt:
Build a bottom sheet over an app frame. Track one value, the sheet offset y (0 open, travel closed), and derive progress p = 1 - y / travel.
Animate y with a spring (stiffness 300, damping 28) seeded with the release velocity; make the sheet taller than its travel so overshoot shows no gap.
From p set the app to scale(1 - 0.06p) with a small downward shift, border-radius 12px * p on the top corners, and a black scrim at opacity 0.42p.
While dragging, follow the pointer 1:1 downward and apply limit * (1 - exp(-excess / limit)) upward. On release close if y > 35% of travel or velocity > 600px/s; a tap toggles.
Under prefers-reduced-motion jump y to its target and keep the same end states.
